intended_behavior: This method should correctly identify orphaned toolUse blocks in the message history and add the exact number of missing toolResult content blocks, ensuring the number of toolResult blocks matches the number of toolUse blocks in the previous assistant message. It should handle partial or total absence of toolResult blocks in the next user message without adding excess blocks, preserving valid conversation state for Bedrock API acceptance.

This function should generate accurate toolResult content blocks corresponding to the provided toolUse IDs with consistent error status and content. It should produce one toolResult block per orphaned toolUse ID. The existing functionality can be maintained, but if needed it should be reviewed to ensure strict one-to-one correspondence in counts.
